about: Blind set for scripts/planner_benchmark.py (--blind). Requests written by two people outside the team (w1, w2) who had not seen the planner prompt or its family list. One object per request: text is the request as written; inventory is hero_kitchen, kitchen_real_01 or office (python scripts/planner_benchmark.py --dry-run prints each one's object and fixture ids); family is the task the request asks for, one of arrival.sim.tasks.SIM_FAMILIES; object is the object id it names in that inventory, or null; author is the writer's id (w1, ...); a row with placeholder true is an example, and the script refuses to run the blind set while any row has it.
